requests.description:
API entry point

Provides links for:
* catalog, your domain's list of datasets
* opendatasoft, all datasets on the Opendatasoft network
requests.name: GET /
requests.note: Replace {{OPENDATASOFT_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: List of all pages from this portal.
requests.name: GET /pages
requests.note: Replace {{OPENDATASOFT_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: A single page's metadata from this portal

requests.note: Replace {{OPENDATASOFT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
